robot: Rethink Sawyer arm with a two-finger gripper, hand driven by Meta-World's mocap target (position deltas, fixed wrist orientation)

frame.suite: Meta-World's world frame (metres; x to the robot's right, y forward away from its base, z up; table top at z = 0)
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: at the arm's base link (world origin, table-top height), +X forward across the table (world +y), +Y the robot's left (world -x), +Z up

arm.note: Sawyer hand on a mocap target: move_robot reaches a hand position by repeated measured steps; the wrist does not rotate and its orientation is not reported. The gripper takes 0 (open) .. 1 (closed).

ee_delta.note: execute_trajectory space ee_delta: each row is one 0.0125 s step; dpos (m) moves the hand's target by that much (at most 0.01 m a step); the wrist does not rotate.

notes: The hand is moved with execute_trajectory space native, action_type ee_delta: rows [dx, dy, dz, grip], each in [-1, 1], one row per 0.0125 s control step (the default dt); dx, dy, dz move the hand's target by 1 cm per step per unit in the world frame (x = the robot's right, i.e. base -Y; y = forward, i.e. base +X; z up), kept inside x in [-0.5, 0.5], y in [0.4, 1.0], z in [0.05, 0.5]; the hand follows the target within a few steps; grip +1 closes, -1 opens. The wrist orientation is fixed. proprio_now holds tcp_x/y/z (the point between the fingertips, world frame), gripper_opening (0 closed .. 1 open) and mocap_x/y/z (the hand's target). The four cameras are fixed.
